description: Returns the canonical public URL for a Neblla app in the gallery. ALWAYS call this after neblla_create_app — never construct the URL yourself. Apps are published and browsed at play.neblla.com. The URL format is https://play.neblla.com/<slug>, where <slug> is auto-generated from the app name at creation time and can be renamed in the dashboard.
name: neblla_get_app_url
